cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

mechanism: A corrects casual verbal approval into a dated record that preserves the starting position even if B later changes it.
confusable: D169 makes B share work; D172 specifically prevents a position from being quietly revised without acknowledgment.
comparison: Repeated festival-budget reversal differs from a neighbor fearing permanent boundary permission.
seedUse: Keep last-year changed mind and dated yes; make A explain recordkeeping through live signature/date corrections.
